newsitem.title: UK: IBCA assigns ratings to Advance Bank $700 mln EMTN.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns ratings to Advance Bank $700 mln EMTN.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it had assigned Advance Bank Australia Limited's $700 MLN Euro Medium Term Note programme ratings of A for senior long-term notes and A1 for senior short-term notes.
IBCA said in a statement that it also assigned a rating of A minus for subordinated long-term notes.
IBCA at the same time affirmed its long-term and short-term credit ratings of Advance Bank at A and A1 respectively.
IBCA said Advance maintained a comfortable financial profile with good asset quality, backed by conservative lending practices and thorough credit appraisal and review processes.
"Advance is the largest Australian regional bank and maintains a significant position in the New South Wales home loan market," the statement said.
The bank's business base was expanded in 1995 through the acquisition of Bank of South Australia Limited from the state governmment of South Australia. -- International Bonds Unit +44 171 542 6320
